title: Aerial view of Núi Bà Đen (Black Lady) Mountain, A-324, during air-drop, 25 December 1965
citation: "[Front]: Aerial view of Nui Ba Den (Black Lady) Mountain A-324 during air-drop. [December 25, 1965]," photograph, Terona Chivers Collection (AFC/2001/001/6049), Veterans History Project, American Folklife Center, Library of Congress.
notes: One of eleven photographs in a 5th Special Forces Group veteran's collection. Its caption is the earliest independent use found of the designation A-324 for the mountain camp by a man who served in Vietnam, rather than by a compiler writing decades later. Read with the collection's other captions - a rigger and warehouseman, a load being stickered, a jump at the Fort Lee drop zone - it indicates the photograph was taken from the aircraft during a supply air-drop onto the summit, and so documents how the camp was resupplied. Dated three and a half months after Larry left Vietnam.
